:::{#def-lp-norm}
#### $L^p$ norm ($p$-norm of a function)

Let $(S, \salg, \measure)$ be a [measure space](#def-measure-space).
For any [real number](number-systems.qmd#def-real-numbers) $p \ge 1$,
the **$L^p$ norm** of a [measurable function](#def-measurable-function) $f : S \to \reals$ is:

$$
\norm{f}_p \eqdef \paren{\int_S \abs{f}^p \, d\measure}^{1/p}.
$$

:::
